Jwt.// SigningKey: No default on purpose. Supply via user-secrets, an environment variable, or a secret store.
Jwt.// AccessTokenLifetime: Kept short on purpose. Logout revokes the refresh token, so this is the longest an already-issued access token can outlive a sign-out.

Identity.// note: Bound to IdentityOptions. ASP.NET Core Identity owns account policy; none of it is reimplemented in the application layer.

Seed.// note: Leave AdminPassword empty to skip seeding. Set both to create an administrator on first run.
